name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer holding a 50% exploration earn-in and a 3% net smelter royalty on the Lapon Canyon Project, located within the Walker Lane gold trend in Nevada. The company is in the exploration stage with active reverse circulation drilling programs targeting historical mine workings and newly identified gold zones. An initial NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate is expected in 2026.
